title: Quantik opening probe v1 metadata header
description: JSON metadata header of an opening-probe.v1 file: a sorted fixed-width binary lookup table derived from an opening-book.v1 SQLite book. File layout: 8-byte magic 'QPROBE\x00\x01', u32 LE metadata_len, metadata_len bytes of UTF-8 JSON (this object, keys sorted), zero padding to a multiple of 8 bytes, then entry_count records of record_size (28) bytes sorted ascending by unsigned bytewise key order. Record: bytes 0..18 canonical_key.v1 (0x01 0x02 then 8 u16 LE planes), byte 18 game_value i8 in {-1,0,1}, byte 19 status u8 (1 = exact, 2 = bounded), bytes 20..28 optimal_actions u64 LE with bit i = action i (shape*16+position) in the canonical representative's orientation. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (per_ply sums to entry_count and matches the records, ply_min <= ply_max, sorted unique keys, SHA-256 of the record region, exact implies a non-zero game_value, legality of mapped-back actions) are checked by scripts/validate_contracts.py. This schema is closed so fixture headers cannot drift; runtime readers ignore unknown optional keys (docs/opening-probe-v1.md section 4). See docs/opening-probe-v1.md.

ply_min.description: Inclusive lower bound of coverage; ply = pieces on board.

per_ply.description: Entries per ply; mirrors opening-book-summary.v1 per_depth. Sums to entry_count.

coverage_complete.description: Optional. True: every canonical position at plies ply_min..ply_max that the source book contains is present, so a miss inside the range means the book had no such position. False or absent: a miss means only that this file does not know.

book_id.description: Changes whenever the source book's nodes, edges, values, policy or annotations change; used by the opt-in stale check.

contract_version.description: Informational: the contracts release the builder validated against. Never an equality gate at runtime (fixtures excepted).

body_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the record region, exactly entry_count * record_size bytes.
